name: Office Setup Variant 3
task:
Please complete the following four-stage office task.

=== Stage 1: Supply Gathering ===
You need to prepare materials for a meeting: 4 copies of agenda (2 pages each), 4 copies of presentation (15 pages each). Supplies: 100 sheets of paper, 4 binders, hole punch, paper clips (box of 50).

=== Stage 2: Document Preparation ===
Print and organize the documents.

=== Stage 3: Assembly ===
Bind and compile the documents.

=== Stage 4: Cleanup ===
Dispose of waste and organize workspace.

subtasks.name: Material and workspace preparation, gathering and processing
